name: mirage
text: Got all 7 NCAAB points and logged them as NC2. It's a substantial change, so I'm building it as one release rather than piecemeal. The order: first let you bet any single line by hand (a +EV warning, never a block), then the colored +/- records and a legend for the boxes, then the moneyline and quick-bet on every row, then alternate spreads and totals, and finally the missing team averages. I'll tell you here when it's out.
